summary: Greenidge Generation Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K furnishing a press release with financial and operating results for Q1 2026. No special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings announcement furnished under Item 8.01 and is not deemed filed for Exchange Act purposes. The press release contains forward-looking statements regarding the company's AI/HPC transition, interconnection expansion, and potential transactions but does not announce any definitive M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. No deal terms or premium are applicable.
